## Learning goals

By the end of this week, you should understand:

- how the course concepts apply to your own team project;
- how to identify and address technical, methodological, legal, or documentation problems; and
- how to prepare for the exam by reviewing the course material and example questions.

## Preparation before the lecture

- Work through the exam preparation material shared on Canvas

## Lecture

- Exam preparation and Q&A
- Questions about applying course concepts to the team projects

## Coaching

- Online coaching session (#3)
- Continue collecting, validating, and documenting your project data.
